evaluation_title: Ransomware Incident Response Orchestrator - Reliability & Failure Scenario Analysis
slack_fault_isolation_guarantee: Verified: Slack delivery failures (unconfigured, HTTP 500, timeout) do not halt or corrupt Jira ticket creation and incident handling.

scenarios.expected_result: Jira ticket creation rejected with HTTP 401; Slack notification aborted; workflow status FAILED
scenarios.actual_result: Validation: VALID, Jira: FAILED, Assignment: UNASSIGNED, Slack: JIRA_FAILED, Workflow: FAILED
scenarios.impact_on_overall_workflow: High. Halts automated ticketing; logs authentication failure; suppresses false-positive Slack alert.

scenarios.expected_result: Jira ticket creation rejected with HTTP 400; downstream assignment and notification aborted; workflow status FAILED
scenarios.actual_result: Validation: VALID, Jira: FAILED, Assignment: UNASSIGNED, Slack: JIRA_FAILED, Workflow: FAILED
scenarios.error_message: Jira ticket creation rejected: HTTP 400 Bad Request
scenarios.impact_on_overall_workflow: High. Aborts downstream notifications to prevent sending invalid tickets; prompts SOC alerting retry.

scenarios.expected_result: Jira ticket created successfully; assignment fails; Slack alert dispatched with UNASSIGNED warning; workflow PARTIAL_SUCCESS
scenarios.actual_result: Validation: VALID, Jira: Created, Assignment: UNASSIGNED, Slack: DELIVERED, Workflow: PARTIAL_SUCCESS
scenarios.impact_on_overall_workflow: Medium. Incident ticket exists in Jira and SOC is alerted; unassigned ticket is highlighted for manual triage.

scenarios.expected_result: Jira ticket created and analyst assigned; Slack returns NOT_CONFIGURED; Jira handling remains completely intact; workflow PARTIAL_SUCCESS
scenarios.actual_result: Validation: VALID, Jira: Created, Assignment: ASSIGNED, Slack: NOT_CONFIGURED, Workflow: PARTIAL_SUCCESS
scenarios.impact_on_overall_workflow: Low. Core incident ticketing in Jira is fully preserved; non-disruptive warning logged for unconfigured Slack.

scenarios.expected_result: Jira ticket created and analyst assigned; Slack returns HTTP 500 error; Jira handling unaffected; workflow PARTIAL_SUCCESS
scenarios.actual_result: Validation: VALID, Jira: Created, Assignment: ASSIGNED, Slack: FAILED, Workflow: PARTIAL_SUCCESS
scenarios.error_message: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error from Slack webhook
scenarios.impact_on_overall_workflow: Low. Jira containment ticket is untouched; webhook delivery failure is captured for retry without impacting incident response.

scenarios.expected_result: Jira ticket created and analyst assigned; Slack network times out; Jira handling unaffected; workflow PARTIAL_SUCCESS
scenarios.actual_result: Validation: VALID, Jira: Created, Assignment: ASSIGNED, Slack: FAILED, Workflow: PARTIAL_SUCCESS
scenarios.error_message: Network connection error connecting to Slack webhook
scenarios.impact_on_overall_workflow: Low. Jira containment ticket remains valid; network partition logs safe error without disrupting core SecOps actions.

scenarios.expected_result: Incident telemetry validation fails immediately; Jira and Slack stages skipped; workflow status FAILED
scenarios.actual_result: Validation: INVALID, Jira: SKIPPED, Assignment: UNASSIGNED, Slack: SKIPPED, Workflow: FAILED
scenarios.error_message: Validation failed: 'Incident Type' is required and cannot be empty.
scenarios.impact_on_overall_workflow: Contained. Malformed threat telemetry is rejected before polluting Jira or spamming Slack channels.

scenarios.expected_result: Existing ticket recognized; duplicate notification suppressed or deduplicated; workflow status SUCCESS
scenarios.actual_result: Validation: VALID, Jira: Existing (Duplicate Avoided), Assignment: ASSIGNED, Slack: SKIPPED_DUPLICATE, Workflow: SUCCESS
scenarios.impact_on_overall_workflow: Positive. Prevents ticket duplication and eliminates alert fatigue in SOC monitoring channels.

scenarios.expected_result: Telemetry validated; Jira ticket created; SOC analyst assigned; Slack notification delivered; workflow status SUCCESS
scenarios.actual_result: Validation: VALID, Jira: Created, Assignment: ASSIGNED, Slack: DELIVERED, Workflow: SUCCESS
scenarios.impact_on_overall_workflow: Ideal. Full end-to-end automated detection, ticketing, assignment, and alerting completed successfully.
